title: Unguarded Bitter Irish Scallion Bowl
description: A romantic Irish dish featuring caramelized scallions, this recipe is perfect for a raw-friendly and bitter meal, served in an earthenware bowl.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large skillet, melt the butter over medium heat and add the chopped scallions.
Cook the scallions for 20 minutes, stirring occasionally, until they are caramelized and golden brown.
In a small bowl, whisk together the olive oil, salt, and black pepper.
Add the crumbly irish cheddar to the bowl and toss to coat with the oil mixture.
To assemble the dish, place a layer of caramelized scallions in the bottom of the earthenware bowl.
Top the scallions with a layer of the crumbly irish cheddar mixture.
Drizzle the caramel sauce over the top of the cheddar layer.
Garnish with chopped fresh parsley and serve immediately.
